test.fill_query: INSERT INTO agg_in_order_partial_key SELECT number, number * 7, number * 11 FROM numbers_mt(100000)
test.query: SELECT a, b, count() FROM agg_in_order_partial_key GROUP BY a, b SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_in_order = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT DISTINCT a, b, c FROM agg_in_order_partial_key SETTINGS optimize_distinct_in_order = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT a, count() FROM agg_in_order_partial_key GROUP BY a SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_in_order = 1 FORMAT Null
